prompt:
Loop 056 — bounded MEDIUM tests/docs-only static-to-live gap audit.

Goal:
Create one machine-checkable audit of the remaining gap between the currently accepted static Relay stack and any future first live provider turn. This task documents and regression-checks unresolved evidence/human-decision gates only. It MUST NOT resolve, simulate resolution of, rank, or choose any live/auth/provenance option.

Read first:
- docs/JULES_TASK_PROMPT_SPEC.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_INVENTORY.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_PROVENANCE_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_PROVENANCE_TRUST_SOURCE_DECISION_SUPPORT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_CONTRACT.md

Allowed changed paths only:
- tests/relay/test_static_to_live_gap_audit.py
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- tests/docs/checkpoint only
- no src/ production implementation changes
- no schemas
- no workflows
- no workflow permissions
- no dependency/lockfile changes
- no GitHub API/client code
- no OIDC token request or attestation
- no provider/model/API/auth/credential/billing/settings mutation
- no live probe or external network action
- no Merge
- no rebase / merge commit / force push / automatic conflict resolution
- retry=0
- fallback=disabled
- do not change files outside the exact allowlist; if a correct solution requires one, STOP and report instead

Existing implementation to reuse:
- Treat the current canonical documents listed under Read first as the source material.
- Reuse their existing blocker names, meanings, and safety boundaries.
- Do not duplicate provider policy/config fixtures or invent new blocker semantics.
- Do not claim external/current provider facts beyond what the checked-in canonical documents establish.
- Existing green tests are evidence only; they do not prove this audit is semantically complete.

Required semantics:
1. Add docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md containing a stable table with one row per remaining gap/gate. Every row must include:
   - gap_id
   - scope/provider
   - class: EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED / FINAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL / DEFERRED_NOT_SELECTED
   - current_state
   - canonical_source
   - what evidence/decision is still missing
   - what must remain forbidden until resolved
2. At minimum, directly represent all current common blockers from RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md:
   - exact finite timeout values
   - exact minimum permission profile
   - executed-model verification mechanism
   - proof intended subscription/auth route is actually paying for the turn
   - provider-specific abort/readback evidence
   - final secret/PII/private-code fan-out patterns
   - live filesystem/network confinement feasibility
   - end-to-end proof no hidden retry/fallback violates policy
3. Represent the provider-specific blocker groups:
   - OpenAI/Codex built-in ChatGPT-auth zero request retry / zero stream-reconnect replay / no auth-recovery replay / single-request evidence
   - Claude automatic model-call retry / model fallback / restart-recovery / account auth / dangerous-skip-permissions false / executed-model verification
   - Google Antigravity intended account route / no API-key-cloud-billing-overage path / internal retry-fallback / executed model / cancellation without restart / quota-billing UNKNOWN stop-before-send
4. Represent Gemini CLI as DEFERRED_NOT_SELECTED and never as an automatic fallback.
5. Represent production provenance trust source as HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED:
   - KEEP_NOT_WIRED remains the safe default
   - Actions readback is transport evidence only / insufficient authenticator
   - OIDC candidate remains NOT_AUTHORIZED
   - Artifact Attestation strong candidate remains NOT_AUTHORIZED
   - make ZERO architecture choice / ZERO permission change
6. Represent the first real provider/model turn as FINAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL even after every technical evidence item and any future provenance verification are satisfied.
7. Explicitly separate:
   STATIC/PREPARED complete != real blocker resolved != provenance verified != execution authorized != first live turn approved.
8. The audit must state that it is a snapshot of current checked-in canonical evidence, not fresh external provider verification.
9. No row may claim PASS/RESOLVED/VERIFIED for a real live blocker unless the existing canonical source already contains direct real-world evidence for that exact blocker. For current unresolved blocker rows, use UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/DEFERRED/HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED as appropriate.
10. Add a short "next safe work" section that classifies possible future work without choosing it:
   - static maintenance/audits may continue
   - read-only evidence gathering may continue when authorized and non-live
   - permission/auth/trust-source changes require explicit human architecture authorization
   - first live provider turn requires explicit human approval
11. Update RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with PREPARED/static gap-audit status only.

Negative / tamper / failure cases:
- tests must read RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md and fail if any of the eight common blocker phrases disappears without the audit being updated
- tests must verify each four provider/transport decision category above is represented
- tests must verify all required gap classes are present
- tests must verify OIDC and Artifact Attestation remain NOT_AUTHORIZED and KEEP_NOT_WIRED remains safe default
- tests must verify Actions readback remains transport evidence only / insufficient authenticator
- tests must verify Gemini CLI remains deferred/not automatic fallback
- tests must verify first live turn remains explicit-human-approved
- tests must reject/flag dangerous resolved wording such as real_live_ready=true, execution_authorized=true, provenance_verified=true, dispatch_allowed=true, LIVE_AUTHORIZED, or REAL_BLOCKERS_RESOLVED
- tests must verify docs say the audit is checked-in evidence only, not fresh external verification
- tests must read RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md and directly assert PREPARED/static/no-live/no-real-blocker-resolution statements
- no vacuous tests: no pass, assertTrue(True), unrelated string-existence assertions pretending to prove behavior

Acceptance criteria:
- changed paths are exactly within the allowlist
- every required common/provider/trust/final-human gate has a direct table row and direct test assertion
- tests parse/inspect the audit structure rather than only checking that the filename exists
- canonical blocker source phrases are cross-checked so source/audit drift fails visibly
- no new architecture choice, permission, auth mechanism, live readiness, or provider execution is claimed
- no existing canonical semantic boundary is weakened
- all negative cases above are directly exercised
- green pre-existing tests alone are not acceptance

Exact validation commands:
Run focused tests first as useful, then exactly once:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Publish the normal isolated Jules PR only if the exact path fence holds, all required semantic assertions are present, full validation is green, and no hard prohibition was crossed. Do not Merge.

Explicit stop conditions:
- stop if a required source document conflicts materially with another canonical source
- stop if any claimed blocker resolution would require fresh external/live evidence
- stop if an out-of-scope file is required
- stop if a permission/auth/billing/live/trust-source architecture decision is required
- stop instead of guessing if current checked-in evidence is insufficient
